_note: Document replacement order for Virginia. Every field comes from the official page in `sources`, read on last_verified. Never guess: a field that could not be confirmed is left empty and named in `unverified_fields`, and the UI says to call the agency. `verified` is true only when every field shown was confirmed. `prerequisites_verified` says whether the official page itself states the dependency.

phases.label: First 48 hours
phases.why: Stop fraud, keep medicines going, and make sure mail reaches you.

phases.label: First week
phases.why: An ID unlocks most other replacements.

phases.label: Later
phases.why: These usually need an ID first, and they are less urgent.

documents.name: Medications
steps: Call your pharmacy and tell them your medicine was lost in the disaster.
Call the doctor or clinic that prescribed it if the pharmacy asks for a new prescription.

documents.name: Bank and credit cards
documents.issuing_agency: The bank or credit union that issued the card
needed_items: The issuer's phone number, from a statement, your online account or the issuer's website
steps: Report the loss to the bank or credit union that issued each card as soon as possible. You can call or use its app.
Follow up with a letter to the issuer. Keep a copy, and notes from your calls.
documents.timing_note: For debit and ATM cards, how much you could lose depends on how fast you report. Reporting before anyone uses the card means you owe nothing.

documents.name: Mail
needed_items: Identity verification, online or with photo ID at a Post Office
steps: If you will be away 15 days to 1 year, request a temporary change of address so mail follows you.
If you can't verify your identity online, go to a Post Office with photo ID.
For 3 to 30 days away, USPS Hold Mail keeps your mail at your local Post Office.
documents.fees_note: Changing your address online has a $1.25 identity verification fee.

documents.name: Driver's license or state ID
needed_items: In person: a completed Driver's License and Identification Card Application
In person: one proof of identity document (more for REAL ID)
In person: a new photo, taken at the DMV
steps: Try the DMV's online replacement first. It is not available if, for example, you are under 18, need a new photo, or owe the DMV money.
Otherwise visit a DMV customer service center, with or without an appointment.
The new card is mailed to you.
documents.fees_note: $20 for a replacement license, plus a one-time $10 for REAL ID.
documents.id_card_note: This DMV page covers driver's licenses and learner's permits. For a state ID card, check with the DMV.

documents.name: Health insurance cards
steps: Medicare: log in to or create a Medicare account online to print a copy or ask for a new card by mail.
Other health insurance: call the number on your insurer's website and ask for a new card.

documents.name: Social Security card
steps: Visit the Social Security Administration website to replace your card online, by mail, or in person.

documents.name: Birth certificate
documents.issuing_agency: Virginia Department of Health, Office of Vital Records
documents.prerequisites_note: Anyone requesting a vital record must send a copy of their ID. A state photo ID works, and so do other IDs on the VDH list, such as a U.S. passport.
needed_items: A legible copy of your ID (see the VDH list of accepted IDs)
steps: Order online, by mail, or at the walk-in lobby in Richmond (8701 Park Central Drive, Suite 100), Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 4 p.m.
Birth records are issued to the person and immediate family members with valid ID.

documents.name: Passport
steps: Report the lost passport online, by phone at 1-877-487-2778, or by mail (form DS-64). Reporting cancels it but does not replace it.
To replace it, apply on form DS-11 at a passport acceptance facility. You can report the loss at the same time.

documents.name: Vehicle title
needed_items: You own or co-own the vehicle
A credit or debit card, or checking account details
steps: Order online if the title was lost or damaged and nothing on it needs to change.
The new title is mailed within 5 business days to the first owner listed on the title record.
documents.fees_note: Ordering online saves $1 compared with other ways.

documents.name: School or work records
steps: Contact the school's records office or your employer's HR department and ask how to request copies.
